source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, income taxes note, cash paid for income taxes
source.quote: The following table summarizes the cash paid for income taxes for the periods indicated (in millions): Year Ended December 31, 2025 Federal (United States) $ 1,139 State 102 Foreign (International) (1) 216 Total (2) $ 1,457 [USD millions; FY2025 only]

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Taxes: from the ASU 2023-09 table of cash paid for income taxes by jurisdiction (net of refunds received, per its footnote), tagged us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet; the supplemental cash-flow disclosures now show only interest. R&D not reported as a separate line. eBay reports 'Product development' ($1,642 million in 2025; tagged us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense in XBRL), which the 10-K does not call research and development, so it is not recorded.
